contract: Source-generation ownership only; hand-authored expectations, no renderer/theme lookup.

cases.name: none
cases.reason: No existing presentation: the source keeps one auto assertion.

cases.name: minor
cases.reason: A visible minor measurement owns presentation without becoming an assertion.

cases.name: swapped-minor
cases.reason: Same vertex and unordered endpoint IDs; directed size is retained.

cases.name: reflex-only
cases.reason: Reflex arc occupies the other sector.

cases.name: reflex-forced-square
cases.reason: Persisted forced square claims the minor marker even with reflex range.

cases.name: never
cases.reason: The user owns the arc choice, not just a right glyph.

cases.name: explicit-zero
cases.reason: Explicit zero appearance is intent, not absence of an IR owner.

cases.name: manual-true
cases.reason: A manual assertion is not replaced or reparented.

cases.name: manual-failed
cases.reason: add_auto_marks does not enforce geometry; a persisted failed assertion still owns its presentation.

cases.name: manual-failed-never-reflex
cases.reason: Assertion ownership survives failed status and an explicit reflex arc.

cases.name: hidden-manual
cases.reason: A hidden other/manual assertion does not claim visible presentation.

cases.name: other-auto-origin
cases.reason: Borrowed auto owner keeps its original source.

cases.name: coordinate-alias-is-not-identity
cases.reason: Even identical evaluated coordinates do not alias stable point IDs.

cases.name: undefined-angle
cases.reason: Distinct IDs can have coincident points; undefined presentation is not an owner.

cases.name: same-batch-defined
cases.reason: The first source creates the one defined owner for later sources, absent from initial evaluation.

cases.name: same-batch-undefined
cases.reason: A fresh undefined mark cannot own later requests; no new degeneracy threshold.

cases.name: same-source-hidden
cases.reason: Existing same-source idempotency precedes visible-owner eligibility.

cases.name: source-suppressed
cases.reason: Explicit source suppression precedes owner creation.
